profile_text.body:
Zebra Technologies Corp is a public company headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, traded under the ticker ZBRA. On its own site the company describes itself as a foundation for intelligent operations, saying it powers intelligent operations to digitize, automate, and enhance processes with mobile computers, scanners, printers, and RFID. It also describes manufacturing technology solutions that include hardware and software for automation, data analysis, and factory connectivity.

On the AI side, the site describes AI software solutions intended to optimize workflows, streamline processes, and simplify tasks for frontline operations. Named offerings include Zebra Companion AI, which the company says provides instant, tailored insights and support, and Zebra Frontline AI Enablers, described as AI vision models, sample apps, and APIs. The site also lists Zebra Frontline AI Blueprints as adaptable AI frameworks that automate manual tasks, and the Zebra Aurora suite of machine vision software, including Zebra Aurora Focus for controlling manufacturing and logistics automation and running Fixed Industrial Scanners and Machine Vision Smart Cameras. The company says its AI is an intelligent and open platform built to integrate with RFID, enterprise software, and machine vision.

The company's record shows no tracked AI products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits. Its law exposure is recorded in Illinois, with a count of 375.
